method: Four bordered rectangles with width >=45 px and height >=20 px. Search +/-5 px around the new predicted edge, require >=70% ink coverage excluding endpoint 3 px. Score both versions against the same detected edge. Unmatched edges are excluded, not counted as passes. Not qualification.
